name: 10128 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10128 (New York) has 445 nonprofit organizations. 155 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 135 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10128 (New York) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
